Name: Actually Rare Green Moonlight Jelly
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[size=6][b][u]Actually Rare Green Moonlight Jelly

[/u][/b][/size][size=3]So Vincent says the Green Moonlight Jelly is "Rare", but it shows up year after year without fail. Well now you can set rarity of this wiggly jellyfish to any percentage you desire! Default chance is 50%.

[u][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size][/u]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:[/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
﻿- and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (GMCM)﻿
[/size]
[size=3]Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)

[size=5][b][u]Configuration
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]Using GMCM you can input any number from 100 to 0, to edit the percentage chance of the Rare Green Moonlight Jellyfish of appearing. Inputting anything other than a number from 100 to 0 will not work. Changing the config ingame requires at minimum a day change for the edit to take effect. This might change in a future CP update.

[size=5][b][u]Extra
[/u][/b][/size][/size][/size]Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/139363413?tab=user+files]Nutzalgia[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/120958053?tab=user+files]violetlizabet (aka Elizabeth)[/url] for helping me with the CP logic.
[/size]100 % of the Donation points goes to [url=https://www.wcs.org/]Wildlife Conservation Society[/url].
